frozen_fusion_rule: outside frozen ROI: p_final_candidate = p_global; inside frozen ROI: p_final_candidate = resized p_refined
frozen_fusion_rule_architecture_spec: outside ROI retain p_global; inside ROI replace with p_refined
structural_enforcement: The global probability map is retained in memory for the whole sample lifetime; the regional candidate is stored separately and only composed at the final selection step.
explicit_somega_to_outcome_mapping_note: The preservation contract freezes the three OUTCOMES (SKIP / EXECUTE_THEN_REJECT / EXECUTE_THEN_ACCEPT) and their final outputs, and the frozen role of S_omega is "quality preservation AFTER refinement". The mapping S_omega-ACCEPT -> EXECUTE_THEN_ACCEPT and S_omega-REJECT -> EXECUTE_THEN_REJECT is strongly implied but is NOT stated as an explicit frozen mapping.
